name: talkwithagent
description: Keep Codex task execution connected to persistent web discussions.

interface.shortDescription: Discuss tasks in the web while Codex executes.
interface.longDescription: Open multiple persistent discussion agents sharing one Codex session's visible context. Read their discussions and confirmed feedback at checkpoints. Requires the TalkWithAgent npm command, Python 3.10+, and a signed-in Codex CLI.
